meta.name: Assess AWS security posture changes with Claude and Slack alerts

parameters.content:
## AI AWS Security & Policy Agent

### How it works

This workflow polls or manually checks AWS security findings, compares them with the previous baseline, and stops early if nothing changed. When changes are detected, it enriches the findings with account asset inventory, uses an Anthropic Claude-powered security agent to assess impact, then routes the case by risk severity. High-risk items can require security lead sign-off, while approved or reviewable findings are written back to the posture system, logged for compliance, distributed to teams, and saved as the new baseline.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger frequency and keep the manual trigger available for test runs.
- Set the AWS account ID, AWS region, security findings API URL, asset inventory API URL, and compliance log API URL in the configuration node or workflow variables.
- Add authentication/credentials for the HTTP requests that fetch findings, read and update asset inventory, and post compliance audit logs.
- Configure the Anthropic/Claude credential used by the security analysis model and review the agent prompt/output expectations.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the destination channels for review, rejection, SecOps, and compliance notifications.
- Configure the email sending credential and recipients for the security summary email.
- Configure the wait/sign-off mechanism so the security lead can approve or reject high-risk cases.
- Ensure the baseline persistence code has access to the intended storage location for saving the latest findings snapshot.

### Customization

Adjust the snapshot comparison logic, AI analysis prompt, severity routing rules, approval requirements, Slack/email recipients, and baseline storage method to match the organization’s risk model and compliance process.

## Start and configure

Provides scheduled and manual entry points, then initializes account, region, and API configuration values used by the rest of the workflow.

## Fetch and compare findings

Retrieves the latest security findings and compares them against the previous snapshot to decide whether further analysis is needed.

## End unchanged cycle

Terminates the run when the comparison shows there are no new or changed findings to process.

## Enrich asset context

Fetches AWS account asset inventory and merges it with the changed security findings to give the AI agent more operational context.

## Analyze security impact

Runs the merged findings through the Security Impact Analysis Agent using the Claude model, then parses the AI response into structured results for routing.

## Route by severity

Branches the analyzed findings based on risk severity, sending higher-risk cases toward approval and other cases toward review notification.

## Security lead approval

Waits for security lead sign-off on high-risk findings and checks whether the response approves or rejects the case.

## Handle rejected cases

Marks rejected high-risk cases with a rejected status and sends a Slack notification about the sign-off rejection.

## Notify for review

Sends lower or reviewable severity findings to Slack before they continue into the posture update path.

## Update and audit

Updates the security posture record in the inventory system, then writes a compliance audit trail entry for the processed finding set.

## Distribute and persist

Sends final notifications to SecOps, compliance, and email recipients, then persists the current findings snapshot as the new security baseline.
